items.question: Your stakeholders request an AI system that can 'understand complex customer needs intuitively.' What approach best translates this vague requirement into actionable specifications?
options: Document the requirement as stated and work with data scientists to interpret it during implementation, trusting their technical expertise to determine what 'intuitive understanding' means in practice.

Decompose the requirement by identifying specific customer interaction scenarios, defining measurable outcomes for each scenario, specifying acceptable accuracy thresholds, and documenting edge cases where the system should escalate to humans.

Create a prototype using existing AI tools to demonstrate possibilities, then iterate with stakeholders based on their feedback about what aspects of the prototype feel 'intuitive' to refine the requirement.

Conduct competitive analysis of similar AI systems in the market, adopt their documented capabilities as the baseline requirement, and present this industry-standard approach to stakeholders for validation.
items.rationale: Decomposing vague requirements into specific scenarios with measurable outcomes creates testable, implementable specifications while maintaining stakeholder intent.

itemBank.dimensionDescription: Expert-level process analysis, AI integration planning, and workflow optimization

items.question: You're analyzing a complex claims adjudication process for AI automation potential. What analysis approach most effectively identifies the highest-value automation opportunities?
options: Map the end-to-end process using BPMN notation, calculate processing times and volumes for each activity, identify high-volume repeatable tasks, and prioritize automation based on volume-time product to maximize total hours saved.

Conduct value stream mapping to identify waste and bottlenecks, analyze decision points for complexity and consistency, assess data availability for each decision, map exception handling patterns, and prioritize opportunities balancing impact, feasibility, and risk.

Interview process stakeholders to identify pain points, survey users about most frustrating tasks, aggregate feedback to find consensus on automation priorities, and validate priorities with management to ensure strategic alignment.

Benchmark against industry automation practices, identify commonly automated activities in similar processes, assess your process for similar patterns, and prioritize automation opportunities that align with proven industry approaches.
items.rationale: Value stream mapping with decision complexity analysis and data availability assessment identifies opportunities where AI can eliminate waste and resolve bottlenecks.

options: Create a comprehensive change management plan with executive sponsorship, conduct impact assessments for each affected role, establish change agent networks, provide hands-on training before go-live, and implement feedback channels for continuous improvement.

Focus on demonstrating quick wins to build confidence, start with enthusiastic early adopters, showcase their success stories to broader organization, gradually expand adoption as success becomes evident, and let positive results drive organic adoption.

Mandate adoption from the top down with clear expectations and deadlines, provide training resources, establish performance metrics tied to AI system usage, and address resistance through management intervention when necessary.

Involve end users in design and testing phases to build ownership, create user advisory boards for ongoing input, implement changes gradually with opt-in periods, and allow users to choose between old and new approaches during transition.
items.rationale: Comprehensive change management with impact assessments, change agents, hands-on training, and feedback channels addresses resistance systematically and ensures smooth adoption.

Focus on demonstrating quick wins to build confidence, start with enthusiastic early adopters, showcase their success stories to broader organization, gradually expand adoption as success becomes evident, and let positive results drive organic adoption.

Mandate adoption from the top down with clear expectations and deadlines, provide training resources, establish performance metrics tied to AI system usage, and address resistance through management intervention when necessary.

Involve end users in design and testing phases to build ownership, create user advisory boards for ongoing input, implement changes gradually with opt-in periods, and allow users to choose between old and new approaches during transition.
items.rationale: Comprehensive change management with impact assessments, change agents, hands-on training, and feedback channels addresses resistance systematically and ensures smooth adoption.

items.question: You need to build a business case for an AI initiative where benefits are partially intangible and will accrue over multiple years. What approach best quantifies value for executive decision-making?
options: Quantify direct cost savings and efficiency gains with detailed calculations, acknowledge intangible benefits qualitatively without forcing quantification, present NPV analysis for tangible benefits, and supplement with strategic rationale for intangible value.

Use proxy metrics to quantify intangible benefits by researching industry benchmarks and similar case studies, convert all benefits to financial terms using conservative assumptions, present total ROI with sensitivity analysis showing impact of assumption variations.

Focus the business case on strategic necessity rather than financial returns, emphasize competitive risks of not investing in AI, benchmark against competitor AI investments, and position the initiative as essential for long-term competitiveness regardless of specific ROI.

Create a portfolio view showing how this AI initiative enables future opportunities, quantify the value of maintaining strategic optionality, present scenario analysis showing potential upside under different market conditions, and emphasize platform benefits beyond immediate use case.
items.rationale: Using proxy metrics with industry benchmarks and conservative assumptions, combined with sensitivity analysis, provides credible financial quantification while acknowledging uncertainty.

itemBank.dimensionDescription: Expert risk assessment, regulatory compliance, and solution validation for AI systems

items.question: Your AI system operates in a regulated industry where model decisions may be audited. What risk mitigation approach best balances innovation with compliance?
options: Implement comprehensive logging of all model inputs, outputs, and decision factors, establish audit trails linking decisions to source data, create explainability reports for regulatory review, maintain model versioning with change documentation, and establish governance for model updates.

Engage legal and compliance teams early in design, implement only AI approaches with established regulatory acceptance, prioritize interpretable models over complex black boxes, establish pre-deployment regulatory reviews, and limit AI use to non-critical decisions until regulatory clarity improves.

Build a compliance-by-design framework with regulatory requirements embedded in technical specifications, implement automated compliance checking, create sandbox environments for regulatory testing, establish clear escalation procedures for edge cases, and maintain ongoing dialogue with regulators.

Focus on human-in-the-loop approaches where AI provides recommendations but humans make final auditable decisions, document human review processes comprehensively, establish that humans can always override AI, and position AI as decision support rather than decision-making to reduce regulatory burden.
items.rationale: Compliance-by-design with embedded requirements, automated checking, sandbox testing, and regulatory dialogue proactively manages risk while enabling innovation.

items.question: Your AI system has been deployed, but adoption rates are below expectations despite positive user feedback. What operational approach best drives adoption?
options: Conduct detailed adoption analysis to identify barriers by user segment, implement targeted interventions addressing specific barriers, establish adoption metrics and goals by segment, create incentive structures rewarding adoption, and provide ongoing support and enablement.

Focus on improving the AI system itself by analyzing feedback for feature gaps, prioritizing enhancements that address common user requests, communicating improvements proactively, and letting product quality drive organic adoption growth over time.

Launch an intensive marketing and communication campaign highlighting success stories, create executive mandate for adoption with accountability metrics, establish adoption as performance review criteria, and provide comprehensive training programs to reduce adoption friction.

Identify and empower adoption champions within each user community, provide champions with advanced training and support, create peer-to-peer learning opportunities, establish user communities for knowledge sharing, and leverage social proof to drive viral adoption.
items.rationale: Detailed barrier analysis with targeted segment-specific interventions addresses root causes of low adoption more effectively than generic approaches.
